payload.title: The 'autonomous permits' legend above ACTION_PERMISSIONS is a hand-kept third list of the table that omits pr_create and pr_push, both of which the table grants to autonomous, and no test ties the legend to the table it calls the single source of truth
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:158-163 (the comment says the table is the SSoT and that the action_permissions test asserts it)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:165-176 (the legend lists eight actions for autonomous and not pr_create or pr_push)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/runtime_profile.py:181-190 (the table grants pr_create and pr_push to strict and autonomous)
aria-kernel/tests/test_runtime_profile.py:886-899 (the wiring-list pin covers the module docstring and enforce_profile_for_action only, not this legend)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per fact (CLAUDE.md single center, no second copy without an invariant): the authority table is the SSoT and the legend is an unpinned copy that is already wrong.
payload.notes: A reviewer auditing which actions the autonomous profile holds from the comment concludes it has no pr_create and no pr_push authority, the two GitHub-facing cells, while the table grants both. The copy already drifted before the push cell was added and the PRPUSH change extended the two lists a test pins but not this one. Close condition: Delete the legend (each table cell already names autonomous explicitly) or replace it with a pointer to ACTION_PERMISSIONS, and add a runtime_profile test that fails if a comment block above the table restates the autonomous set differently from the keys whose value contains 'autonomous'. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
